fact: The APD's own register of contravention deliberations lists, by year of decision, four sanctions dated 2024 (MAXAM, Banco Comercial do Huambo, UNITEL, COSAL) and three dated 2025 (BDA and two against TAAG), with amounts; the register omits ENDE-EP, sanctioned on 19 July 2024 per the APD's notice, so its 2024 list is incomplete.
title: Deliberação sobre processos contravencionais
